detail_html:
⚙️ Performance Overview

The Ryzen 7 7800X3D, with its Zen 4 architecture, delivers excellent single- and multi-threaded performance. Whether you're gaming, streaming, or handling productivity tasks, this CPU doesn't flinch. It’s efficient, fast, and built for modern workflows.

Paired with the RTX 5060 Ti, this rig absolutely crushes 1440p gaming. Frame rates are consistently high, even in demanding titles with ray tracing enabled. Thanks to NVIDIA’s DLSS 3, you get stunning visuals without sacrificing smoothness. It’s also a great combo for creators working with video editing, 3D rendering, or AI-assisted tasks.

🎮 Gaming Experience

From Call of Duty and Forza Horizon 5 to Hogwarts Legacy and Starfield, this setup handles it all with ease. Expect high settings at 1440p with minimal drops in frame rate, even in the most graphically intense scenes. Competitive gamers will also appreciate the responsiveness and high FPS in esports titles like Apex Legends and Valorant.

🖼️ Aesthetics & Build

The curved tempered glass case is a real showpiece. It adds a touch of elegance and uniqueness, standing out from the typical flat-glass enclosures. The interior layout is clean, with great airflow and smart cable management, making sure the performance isn’t just skin deep. RGB lighting reflects beautifully off the curved glass, giving the whole build a futuristic vibe.

🔧 Thermals & Noise

With good case ventilation and quality cooling, thermals are well-managed even under load. The system stays relatively quiet, even when gaming or rendering, thanks to efficient fan placement and the optimized airflow design
